_comment: Known-incompatible mod pairs. 'trust' 0..1 reflects how certain the incompatibility is. Severity: info|warning|critical.

pairs.note: OptiFine and Sodium both replace the render pipeline and cannot coexist.
Rubidium is a Forge port of Sodium; do not install both.
Embeddium is the maintained successor to Rubidium.
Both rewrite the lighting engine; Starlight supersedes Phosphor.
Oculus is a shader mod for the Sodium/Rubidium stack; conflicts with OptiFine.
